simple.meaning: עֲשִׂירִי (ʻăsîyrîy) is a Hebrew object word meaning “tenth ; by abbreviation, tenth month or (feminine) part.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 8:5. The surrounding context includes flock, offering, altar, priesthood, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲשִׂירִי (H6224) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
